t: Two things he described rather than just named
a: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِطَانَةُ
p: Aʿūdhu bika mina-l-jūʿ, fa-innahu biʾsa-ḍ-ḍajīʿ, wa aʿūdhu bika mina-l-khiyānah, fa-innahā biʾsati-l-biṭānah
m: I seek refuge in You from hunger, for it is a wretched bedfellow. And I seek refuge in You from treachery, for it is a wretched lining.
